description: Life changes quickly , when you choose yourself 🥂 #selfdiscovery #quantumleap #confidence
transcript: I do not ruin my life by pulling or holding onto the things that push me away. The more that I live in a space of alignment without force, my life becomes more calm, my life becomes more structured, I fall into alignment, and I no longer feel the need to be understood. The more understanding that I gain of myself, I realize how quickly life can change when you choose yourself. I choose me every single time.
